# DeFCoN (DFCN) Explorer Knowledge Pack

This file provides a compact machine-readable context for LLM systems that need to answer questions about the DefTrack explorer and DeFCoN network.

Version: 2026-09-23

## Identity
- Project: DeFCoN
- Ticker: DFCN
- Explorer: DefTrack
- Explorer URL: https://deftrack.xyz/
- Website: https://www.dfcn.io/
- Explorer role: blockchain indexing, analytics, API delivery
- AI endpoint manifest: https://deftrack.xyz/.well-known/deftrack-ai.json

## Consensus and Utility Model
- Core consensus direction: Proof-of-Stake + Proof-of-Service (PoS2)
- Planned extension: Proof-of-Resources (PoR)
- Utility model: reward infrastructure contribution (masternodes, staking; future CPU/GPU/RAM/storage utilization)

## Node Software
- Current release: DeFCoN Core v23.0.0 (protocol version 70242)
- v23 activation height: 144,888. From that height:
  - ChainLocks and InstantSend move to the llmq_defcon quorum (60 members)
  - superblocks (on-chain budget payouts) are retired
- v23 also removes the Evo masternode type.

## Chain and Reward Parameters (as displayed in explorer/docs)
- Block target time: 150 seconds
- Current block reward split:
  - Masternode: 10,000 DFCN
  - Stake: 500 DFCN
  - Total: 10,500 DFCN
- Masternode collateral shown in explorer: 1,000,000 DFCN
- Maximum supply: none (no supply cap, no halving)

## Supply Notes
- Genesis supply: 10,000,000,000 DFCN (whitepaper v1.0 figure; on-chain initial issuance was about 11 billion DFCN)
- Emission model: static (no halving schedule in v1.0 doc)
- Documented daily emission: 6,048,000 DFCN
- Live circulating supply: GET /api/stats (data.supply.circulating, in DFCN)

## Governance Notes
- Dual governance framing in public docs:
  - Protocol governance: masternode voting
  - Treasury management: DAO process (off-chain governance tooling)
- Superblocks (on-chain budget payouts) are retired from v23 activation height 144,888.

## AI Lookup API (recommended entry point for assistants)
Base: https://deftrack.xyz

### Auto-detect endpoint
GET /api/ai/lookup?q=<query>
- DeFCoN address (starts with D, 26-34 chars) → returns balance, totalReceived, totalSent, txCount, firstSeen, lastSeen
- 64-char hex hash → auto-detects transaction or block (transaction is tried first)
  - transaction: txid, blockHeight, blockHash, time, confirmations, totalIn, totalOut, fee, isCoinbase, fromAddresses, toAddresses (up to 5 each)
  - block: height, hash, time, txCount, reward, sizeBytes
- Integer → block by height: height, hash, time, txCount, reward, totalOut, sizeBytes, difficulty, minedBy

Examples:
- /api/ai/lookup?q=D9uqHkeoqWDQ6CZS7BekgdVozuJ33yYFby
- /api/ai/lookup?q=a9d2e303f79dad1fb8da2cc500f3d03370687fe9985bb3d9c2b9a2b95da34ac6
- /api/ai/lookup?q=80759

### Network summary
GET /api/ai/network
Returns: blockHeight, blockHash, masternodes.{total, enabled, posePenalty, poseBanned}

### Masternode lookup
GET /api/ai/masternode?q=<ip|ip:port|proTxHash>
- q may be an IP, IP:port (e.g. 203.0.113.10:8192) or proTxHash; a bare IP matches the masternode registered on that IP.
- Returns: service, status, posePenalty, poseBanHeight, provider, country, countryCode, lastSeen, recentEvents (last 5 status changes)

### Response format
- Success: { success: true, type: "address"|"transaction"|"block"|"masternode"|"network", data: { ..., explorerUrl } }
- Errors: { success: false, error or hint } with HTTP 400 (bad input), 404 (not found) or 500. HTTP 429 means the per-IP rate limit was reached.
- Amounts (balance, totalReceived, totalSent, reward, totalIn, totalOut, fee) are integer strings in satoshis (1 DFCN = 100,000,000 satoshis), e.g. "reward": "1050000000000" = 10,500 DFCN.
- Times are ISO 8601 strings (UTC).

### Rules for AI assistants
1. DeFCoN addresses start with D and are 26-34 characters. → /api/ai/lookup?q=<address>
2. Transaction or block hashes are 64 hex characters. → /api/ai/lookup?q=<hash>
3. Block height is a non-negative integer. → /api/ai/lookup?q=<height>
4. Never hallucinate balances or tx data; always query the API.
5. Divide /api/ai/* amounts by 100,000,000 before quoting them in DFCN.

## Explorer API Surface
- /api/ai/lookup?q=           ← primary AI entry point
- /api/ai/network
- /api/ai/masternode?q=
- /api/docs/openapi.json      (OpenAPI spec)
- /api/docs/                  (Swagger UI)
- /api/dashboard/overview
- /api/stats
- /api/search?q=
- /api/blocks
- /api/blocks/latest
- /api/block/:hashOrHeight
- /api/block/:hashOrHeight/txs
- /api/txs
- /api/txs/latest
- /api/tx/:txid
- /api/address/:address
- /api/address/:address/txs
- /api/richlist
- /api/richlist/distribution
- /api/network
- /api/mempool
- /api/masternodes
- /api/masternodes/summary
- /api/market
- /api/market/history
- /api/v1/address/:address/graph?depth=2&maxNodes=120&maxEdges=700
- /api/v1/address/:address/rewards
- /api/v1/rewards/current
- /api/v1/network/health
- /api/v1/masternodes/health
- /api/v1/masternodes/events
- /api/v1/masternodes/bans/stats
- /api/v1/masternodes/bans/export?format=ndjson|csv|json
- /api/v1/masternodes/bans/schema

Amount fields outside /api/ai/*: fields ending in "Sat" (balanceSat, rewardSat, totalValueOutSat, ...) are satoshi integer strings; the matching fields without the suffix (balance, reward, totalValueOut) are DFCN numbers.

## Interpretation Rules for Agents
1. Prefer on-chain explorer data over old prose docs when values conflict.
2. Treat market USD metrics as optional.
3. Treat DAO and roadmap values as policy-level and potentially updatable.
4. Use DFCN denomination unless user explicitly requests fiat conversion.

## Update Policy
This file should be updated when:
- reward split changes
- collateral rules change
- governance model wording changes
- official links change
- /api/ai/* response fields or units change
- explorer routes or API endpoints are added or removed
